statements.speaker: ELENA
statements.text: A man wearing a dark jacket came toward me and demanded all the money.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Could you identify him from the view you had?

statements.speaker: ELENA
statements.text: I saw his clothing and heard his voice. I am not sure I could recognize his face later.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Did you see who moved people toward the rear?

statements.speaker: ELENA
statements.text: I saw people go back and someone wave them there, but I was focused on the counter.

statements.speaker: ELENA
statements.text: I remember a woman near the brochures, but I did not see her carry anything.

statements.speaker: ELENA
statements.text: I cannot give an exact amount; the audit team has the records.
